newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumikin forms livestock firm in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Sumikin forms livestock firm in Australia.

text.p: Japanese trading house Sumikin Bussan Kaisha Ltd has formed a livestock venture in Australia, acquiring a livestock division of the country's major stockbreeder, R.J. Gilbertson Ltd.
The new venture, called SBA Foods Pty. Ltd and located in Victoria, Australia, is capitalised at about two billion yen, of which Sumikin holds 77 percent stake.
The new venture is expected to export Australian beef to Japan, South Korea and other nations, it said.

"Japan's dependance on beef imports will inevitably increase since domestic beef production has fallen. Therefore, the importance of securing beef supply sources is likely to grow," a company spokesman said.
The company said it expects sales of the new venture to total about 18 billion yen in the initial year and about 27 billion yen after three years.
